say:1:1310820001:0.source_cn: 唔，看起来你确实和奇怪的祭典循环没关系……

say:3:1310820002:1.text: Were it not for you, I would've remained ignorant of the events that transpired in Cedartown.
say:3:1310820002:1.source_cn: 如果不是你们找来，我甚至不知道雪松镇上后来发生的事。

say:4:1310820004:0.text: This "time loop", as you called it, reminds me of the Frost Furie... Her powers and the coldness she wrought could even freeze time itself.
say:4:1310820004:0.source_cn: 但“时间循环”……那是当年“冰之恶魔”最让人无法抵抗的...

say:5:1310820005:1.text: Freeze time? But how could time be frozen?!
say:5:1310820005:1.source_cn: 冻结时间？时间怎么可能被冻结？！

say:6:1310820006:1.text: I am uncertain... The ways of the Hypogean elude me. But this has claimed the lives of numerous warriors.
say:6:1310820006:1.source_cn: 我不知道……我不懂恶魔。但有很多勇敢的战士都因此牺牲。

say:9:1310820008:0.text: Oh, could it be another Hypogean this time...? Hey, what's going on over there?
say:9:1310820008:0.source_cn: 难道这次又是恶魔……咦，那边有什么动静？

choice:2:0:1.text: Have you seen anything odd lately?
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 你身边是否有什么异常？
choice:2:0:1.male: Have you seen anything odd lately?
choice:2:0:1.female: Have you seen anything odd lately?

say:11:1310820003:1.text: No, I've not heard of such a thing in the two thousand years I've been here.
say:11:1310820003:1.source_cn: 不，这两千年来，我不曾听说过有这种事情。
say:11:1310820003:1.male: No, I've not heard of such a thing in the two thousand years I've been here.
say:11:1310820003:1.female: No, I've not heard of such a thing in the two thousand years I've been here.

choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 过去曾发生过相似的事情吗？
